column8: UPDATE: Just minutes after my previous tweet went out, the NHC declared #Florence to be a cat 1 with 75 mph max sustained winds, making it the 3rd hurricane of the Atlantic season. #HurricaneFlorence https://t.co/PUPqZvbXHd
@WeatherNation TWC has just reported that #Florence is now a CAT4.   #HurricaneFlorence

#Florence has rapidly intensified & is now a Category 4 #hurricane. Its path beyond this weekend remains highly uncertain, but residents of Bermuda & the U.S. East Coast should pay close attention to the 4cast: https://t.co/BW2qvvw3F0 https://t.co/od7BV5YwIB

Hurricane #Florence is now a major category 4 storm in the Atlantic Ocean.  Winds are 130mph.  There is a lot of uncertainty where the storm moves next week.  We will keep a close eye on the forecast path for you! https://t.co/AU20C3aipD
